headers.comment: Same reason as /prompt-gym/** below: the games and the site-wide sign-in ship unhashed filenames, and /auth/auth.js is shared by every page, so a stale copy for an hour after a deploy would mix old and new code. `no-cache` revalidates; an unchanged file still costs only a 304.

The SPA ships unhashed filenames, so Firebase's default max-age=3600 leaves returning visitors running an old app.js against a new index.html for an hour after every deploy. `no-cache` still caches — it just revalidates first, so an unchanged file costs a 304. Scoped to /prompt-gym/** so nothing about the blog's caching changes.
